rules.city_rule: removed when the map distance (reference pixels * km_per_px) from EarthMaps' in-map city position to an adopted hotspot centre is at most radius + jitter + margin; great_circle_extra lists what a great-circle reading would add
rules.hotspot_adopted_when: strength >= 2 and centre inside the map extent
rules.unnamed_gap_rule: where no researched pass exists, the ridge builder opens an unnamed pass-width gap at the lowest-curvature crest point at least every unnamed_gap_every_km of crest; a pass-free stretch of L km needs ceil(L / unnamed_gap_every_km) - 1 (ranges[].unnamed_gaps_per_stretch)
rules.river_order: Europe's named rivers by S4 path length, longest first, then the map's adopted extras by length; the waterway slice cuts from the bottom of a list when the timed budget requires it
rules.river_width_tiles: max(river_floor_tiles, river_k[class] * scale); straits keep S4's rule with their 7 and 11 tile floors; canals max(7, scale)
rules.river_major_rule: the longest third (rounded up) of each map's adopted list by S4 path length, or map_km (length_px * km_per_px) over river_major_km; rivers[] rows carry class (null when not adopted) and map_km
rules.ford_rule: a walkable water-shallow ford every ford_every_px reference px of each river's path, ford_length_tiles long and spanning the river; straits and canals get none
rules.hotspot_centre: lat and lon are the centre the build uses; cited_lat and cited_lon are R7a's site. They differ only where sea_rule.status is moved_inland
rules.hotspot_sea_rule: refute ruling 16: an adopted onshore hotspot whose disc holds more than sea_share_max water in the reference land mask (rivers and lakes count as water) moves its centre by whole reference pixels, at most jitter_km, to the point whose disc holds the most land on every map that adopts it; if none reaches sea_share_max it stays at the cited site, listed for Jake. The build's realised-amount checks count only the land part of each disc
